text:
Juno: Quick PSA: someone crowned the office cactus with a tiny sticky note crown. Instant morale boost. :cactus:
Kai: photos or it didn’t happen. Did we just invent a holiday? :camera_flash:
Marta: photo uploaded to #random-photos. Also proposing a coronation ritual: stomp once, whisper a commit hash, bow.
Doorman Dan: solemn oath: the cactus shall be called Captain Prickles. It now has guardianship over lost post-its.
Juno: Captain Prickles it is. Can we get a tiny sash? "Captain Prickles, Keeper of Desk Plants".
Kai: ops-bot can you run a poll: sash colour (gold / teal / ridiculous neon)? :robot_face:
ops-bot: Poll created: "Captain Prickles sash color" Options: Gold / Teal / Neon. React to vote.
Marta: voted Gold. :star:
Juno: voted Teal (but open to neon if morale impact > 7). :sparkles:
Doorman Dan: voted Gold. Also adding a clause: anyone who steals Captain Prickles faces immediate (friendly) sticker shaming.
Kai: I will make a tiny coronation certificate and laminate it. Low-effort dignity.
Juno: adding to onboarding: "Where to find Captain Prickles and how to pay respects." :seedling:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Captain Prickles sash poll closes in 24h". :bell:
